description: Create, update, pause, resume, rotate the signing secret of, test, retry a delivery for, or delete a webhook destination on the user's account — the same operations as Dashboard → Developer API. Secrets come back only for create and rotate. Requires the user's confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

events.description: create/update: event types to subscribe to.

url.description: create/update: the receiver URL (https in production).

webhook_id.description: Required for every action except create.

name: manage_webhooks
title: Manage my webhook destinations
